# rethy11 — Engineering Portfolio

> A one-person engineering portfolio hosted on GitHub Pages. Indexes five solo-built projects: a puzzle generator, a game engine, an auth/2FA flow, a performance diagnostics tool, and a minimal search redirector. This site is a static index page — it does not itself run any of the linked projects' code.

Each linked project has its own scope, repo, and (where relevant) its own Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rethy11.github.io/index.html): Project index listing all five shipped systems with descriptions and technical highlights.
- [About](https://rethy11.github.io/about.html): What this site is, contact info, and links to policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rethy11.github.io/privacy.html): Privacy policy for this index page.
- [Terms of Use](https://rethy11.github.io/terms.html): Terms of use for this index page.

## Projects

- [Owldoku](https://owldoku.com): Queens-style puzzle game with a custom constraint-satisfaction generator and a "No Lines" diagonal-exclusivity mode.
- [Slime Sliders](https://rethy11.github.io/Slime-Sliders): ~12,000-line canvas-based game engine with custom physics and procedural level generation.
- [Access](https://rethy11.github.io/phone-verif): Password-and-phone-gated demo using Firebase Phone Authentication (SMS OTP) and reCAPTCHA.
- [Load-Watt](https://rethy11.github.io/Load-Watt): Browser performance and power-diagnostics tool with runtime instrumentation and sandboxed profiling.
- [Slopless](https://rethy11.github.io/Slopless): Minimal, fast, privacy-conscious search redirector with no analytics or telemetry.
